i.norm: Verifies that "Smyth" encodes to "SMYTH" under the Match Rating Approach algorithm. The MRA algorithm uppercases the name, removes non-leading vowels (none present here since Y is not treated as a vowel), removes double consonants (none present), and then returns the first+last 3 characters — but since the result is only 5 characters, it is returned unchanged as "SMYTH".
